note: Russian source is what a dispatcher types today. The English line is the LITERAL translation plus speech normalisation - the register decided with the user on 2026-09-06: nothing is added that the operator did not say. In production this line comes from the translator model; here it is written by hand so the bench measures the VOICE rather than the translator.

phrases.ru: 1-Адам-12, ответьте на угол Гроув-стрит и Мэйн, драка.
phrases.en: One Adam Twelve, respond to Grove Street and Main, fight in progress.
phrases.why: callsign and address normalisation - the digits must be spoken, not read as a number

phrases.ru: ОТКРЫТ ОГОНЬ ПО ОФИЦЕРУ, ВСЕ СВОБОДНЫЕ НА ИДЛВУД!
phrases.en: Shots fired at an officer! All available units, Idlewood!
phrases.why: the caps case - the operator's own explicit shout signal

phrases.en: Ten four, en route, two minutes out.
phrases.why: the dictionary case - short, constant, said fifty times a shift, so it is baked once and never paid for again

phrases.en: Dispatch, requesting backup, suspect is armed.
phrases.why: urgent without caps - only the classifier can raise this one

phrases.ru: Всем постам, код 4, обстановка под контролем.
phrases.en: All units, code four, situation under control.
phrases.why: a numeric code that must survive translation intact

phrases.ru: Преследование, серый Sultan, движется на север по Мулхолланд.
phrases.en: In pursuit, gray Sultan, northbound on Mulholland.
phrases.why: a model name the translator must NOT translate
